import sqlite3, json, statistics as st
c = sqlite3.connect("file:wfscan.db?mode=ro", uri=True); c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
rid = c.execute("SELECT max(run_id) FROM runs").fetchone()[0]
rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT run_id,sym,tf,verdict,reason,oos_sum,oos_fee2,oos_n,ho_net,ho_n,ho_fee2,grid_oos_mean,grid_ho_mean,ho_pos_share,corr_mean,price_ho,t_days,rows,elapsed FROM jobs WHERE run_id=?", (rid,))]
print("done", len(rows), "of 240")
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
print("verdicts", dict(Counter(r["verdict"] for r in rows)))
bt = defaultdict(Counter)
for r in rows: bt[r["tf"]][r["verdict"]] += 1
print("by tf", {k: dict(v) for k, v in bt.items()})
ev = [r for r in rows if r["oos_sum"] is not None and r["verdict"] in ("PASS", "FAIL")]
print("evaluated", len(ev))
def share(f): return round(100.0 * sum(1 for r in ev if f(r)) / max(1, len(ev)), 1)
print("share oos_sum>0:", share(lambda r: r["oos_sum"] > 0), "| oos_fee2>0:", share(lambda r: r["oos_fee2"] > 0), "| ho>0:", share(lambda r: r["ho_net"] > 0), "| ho_fee2>0:", share(lambda r: r["ho_fee2"] > 0), "| oos_sum>grid_oos_mean:", share(lambda r: r["oos_sum"] > r["grid_oos_mean"]))
print("median oos_sum %.1f  median oos_fee2 %.1f  median ho %.1f  median grid_oos_mean %.1f  median grid_ho_mean %.1f" % tuple(st.median([r[k] for r in ev]) for k in ("oos_sum", "oos_fee2", "ho_net", "grid_oos_mean", "grid_ho_mean")))
print("median ho_pos_share %.2f  median corr %.2f" % (st.median([r["ho_pos_share"] for r in ev]), st.median([r["corr_mean"] for r in ev if r["corr_mean"] is not None])))
print("\nPASS rows:")
for r in rows:
    if r["verdict"] == "PASS": print({k: r[k] for k in ("sym", "tf", "oos_sum", "oos_fee2", "oos_n", "ho_net", "ho_n", "ho_fee2", "grid_oos_mean", "grid_ho_mean", "ho_pos_share", "corr_mean", "price_ho", "t_days")})
print("\nbest oos_fee2 (top 8) / worst:")
for r in sorted(ev, key=lambda r: -r["oos_fee2"])[:8]: print(r["sym"], r["tf"], r["verdict"], "oos %.1f fee2 %.1f n %s ho %.1f(n%s) gridho %.1f price %.0f" % (r["oos_sum"], r["oos_fee2"], r["oos_n"], r["ho_net"], r["ho_n"], r["grid_ho_mean"], r["price_ho"]))
print("fail reasons count:")
cnt = Counter()
for r in rows:
    if r["verdict"] == "FAIL":
        for x in r["reason"].split("; "): cnt[x] += 1
for k, v in cnt.most_common(): print(" ", v, k)
print("nodata reasons:", dict(Counter((r["reason"] or "")[:40] for r in rows if r["verdict"] == "NODATA")))
print("by tf medians (evaluated): tf n  med_oos  med_fee2  med_ho  med_grid_oos")
for tf in ("15m", "5m", "1h", "30m", "4h", "2h"):
    e = [r for r in ev if r["tf"] == tf]
    if e: print(tf, len(e), *["%.1f" % st.median([r[k] for r in e]) for k in ("oos_sum", "oos_fee2", "ho_net", "grid_oos_mean")])
print("elapsed median by tf:", {tf: round(st.median([r["elapsed"] for r in rows if r["tf"] == tf])) for tf in {r["tf"] for r in rows}})
